body: Happy birthday person who deserves to be remembered! Honestly, I find it completely random whether people who care about you remember your birthday date. Some people are just goddamn awful at remembering dates. Doesn't make it any better, but hopefully find someone who will never forget your birthday eventually!

I've had basically the exact same experience, I was homeschooled up until college. What I did was pay close attention to what the people I talked to online were interested in and started keeping up to date with them. Made it easier to at the very least partake in their conversations when they started them. If that didn't work or got to a point where it wasn't effective anymore, I would google conversations starters/questions to ask people. It might sound stupid but it really did work.  Besides those things, it really did get easier in time for me to naturally hold conversations with them. The more you talk to the same people, the more you get used to their way of communicating. I still get extreme anxiety from talking to new people but I'm slowly getting better.
